statement: Let d >= 2 and the RWRE satisfy (UE) and (IID) and be transient in direction l. Is the walk necessarily ballistic in direction l?
status_search: Bounded search 2026-09-07: Guerra and Ramirez (arXiv 1809.02011, 'A proof of Sznitman's conjecture about ballistic RWRE') proved the equivalence of conditions (T) and (T'), which is Open question 3.28 of the source, NOT this question; no proof that transience implies ballisticity in d >= 2 was found.
title: Transience in a direction implies ballisticity for uniformly elliptic i.i.d. RWRE in d >= 2
